scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns 0 on a newly constructed Payment object before any setter is called.
getPayment_id() returns the value set by setPayment_id when setPayment_id(42) is called.
getPayment_id() returns the most recently set value when setPayment_id is called multiple times with different values.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MAX_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MAX_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MIN_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MIN_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns a negative value after setPayment_id(-1) is called.
getPayment_id() returns zero after setPayment_id(0) is called.
getPayment_id() returns a positive value after setPayment_id(12345) is called.
getPayment_id() returns the correct value when Payment is persisted and reloaded from the database (JPA @Id field context).
getPayment_id() returns 0 after setPayment_id(0) is called.
getPayment_id() returns a negative value after setPayment_id(-1) is called.
getPayment_id() returns the value set by setPayment_id when called after setting other unrelated fields.
getPayment_id() returns the correct payment_id when the object is loaded from a persistence context with a non-default value.
getPayment_id() returns the correct payment_id when the object is loaded from a persistence context with the default value (0).
